name: Selene ~Apoptosis~
source:
A beautiful stranger appears at your doorstep. Will you let her in? Dive into an erotic nightmare and decide the fates of those around you in this mystic thriller visual novel.

It all begins as a beautiful stranger appears at a lonesome doorstep. This is a love story of a man who slept too little and a stray cat.

Selene ~Apoptosis~ is a free mystic thriller visual novel filled with dark romance and even darker secrets. Fight for those you love. Fight for your life. Find the truth.

And, most importantly, eat well.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398210/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一位美丽的陌生人出现在你的门口。你会让她进来吗？在这部神秘惊悚视觉小说中，潜入情色噩梦，决定身边人们的命运。

一切始于一位美丽陌生人，来到一扇孤寂的家门前。这是一个缺乏睡眠的男人与一只流浪猫的爱情故事。

《Selene ~Apoptosis~》是一部免费的神秘惊悚视觉小说，充满黑暗的爱情，以及更加黑暗的秘密。为所爱之人而战，为自己的生命而战，寻找真相。

最重要的是，好好吃饭。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398210/]Steam[/url]]
